summary: dionysuzx 提交 Hegotá meta EIP 更新，把 EIP-8141（frame 交易）列为考虑纳入（CFI），EIP-7716 与 EIP-8205 列为提议纳入，依据是此前 ACD 会议的决定。lightclient 为 frame 加入 `value` 字段，当天提交并合并。Trail of Bits 发现 Google 用来披露量子破解成果的 ZK 证明体系中，任何人都能伪造一个更强攻击的“证明”。

keywords_en: Hegotá meta EIP update puts EIP-8141 in CFI
EIP-8037 checks block gas limits per dimension
EIP-7954 raises the contract code limit to 64KiB
ZK proof for Google's quantum result could be forged
summary_en: dionysuzx submitted a Hegotá meta EIP update listing EIP-8141 (frame transactions) as Considered for Inclusion (CFI) and EIP-7716 and EIP-8205 as Proposed for Inclusion, based on earlier ACD call decisions. lightclient added a `value` field to frames, submitted and merged the same day. Trail of Bits found that in the ZK proof setup Google used to disclose its quantum breakthrough, anyone could forge a "proof" of an even stronger attack.
